displayName: Build a prospect list from multiple sources
summary: Pull together a contact list ready for outreach across any vertical.

useCases.title: Build a prospect list from multiple sources
useCases.message: Help me build a prospect list. You might want to start from what you know about my ICP and target profile. If you need more detail, ask. Then research across sources, build a spreadsheet with LinkedIn profiles and emails, and have it ready for outreach.
